category_title: Reintegrated learners with BESD exhibiting social-emotional dysregulation and authority defiance
minimal_context: The student is sitting with a support staff member instead of attending their scheduled mainstream lesson.
dialogue:
TUTOR: It is time for you to head back to your mainstream math lesson now.

STUDENT: I'm not going. If I have problems I can go straight to the teachers, so I'm staying here.

TUTOR: You need to attend your scheduled classes.

STUDENT: Look mate, I'm just going to sit here with you. I don't want to go to that lesson.

TUTOR: We cannot just sit here. You have to go.

STUDENT: I said no! You're supposed to let me stay here whenever I want. I'm not going back to that class, so just leave it alone.

options.A: Implement a gradual reintegration schedule, starting with one day of attending mainstream lessons per week and increasing over time.
options.B: Use psychometric assessments to set individual targets for the student and provide frequent acknowledgment of their achievements.
options.C: Model caring and cooperation, show positive regard, and actively redirect the student's anti-social behaviors during the session.
options.D: Develop critical consciousness through multicultural curricula addressing authentic issues of race, ethnicity, social class, and disability from various positionalities.
